_about: John Potter (c.1674-1747), Archbishop of Canterbury, raw IA OCR of Archaeologia Graeca, or the Antiquities of Greece, the Edinburgh new edition with George Dunbar's appendix (1818), 2 vols; not Beatrix Potter, whose shelf is potter.
